The [[Deldrimor Daggers]] were introduced in the [[Game updates/20080424|April 24, 2008 game update]] and are part of the Deldrimor set. They are inscribable.

==Acquisition==
Crafted by [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]] in [[Droknar's Forge (explorable area)]] for: 10 {{plat}}, 10 {{Deldrimor Steel}}, and 10 {{steel}}.

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]] 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Inscription]]: None

==Dye==
[[Dye]] affects the dagger's grip. The default color can be closely replicated using brown dye.
{{dye chart}}

== Notes ==
*Although all three of the [[Unique item|green]] Deldrimor daggers using this skin deal slashing damage, these deal piercing.
